purpose: Define one leakage-safe, nested, grouped evaluation protocol for every trainable real-QPU method evaluated on the canonical 8,767-observation ledger. This contract defines assignments and validation only; it does not materialize a split, train a model, or alter historical split artifacts.

scope.target_concept: source-defined observed one-circuit execution/service time in seconds
scope.canonical_universe: all 8,767 canonical observations; a method must emit prediction or explicit terminal non-prediction state for every row in its declared panel
applies_to: any trainable calibration layer around an analytical predictor
any later trainable method accepted into the signed V2 method-by-dataset matrix

master_outer_protocol.test_definition: For outer fold k, exactly those observations with outer_fold=k are held out. All observations with outer_fold!=k are outer-train.
master_outer_protocol.assignment_unit: unified_leakage_group_id, never an individual dataframe row

base_assignment.policy: Import the source's frozen primary fold as evidence: Ma-Li primary_fold, Qonductor primary_fold, and QPack workflow_fold. Do not reseed, rebalance, or optimize these historical source assignments during V2 materialization.

cross_source_lineage_rule.purpose: Prevent a proven duplicate circuit/workflow lineage from appearing in outer train through one source and outer test through another.
admissible_evidence: identical canonicalized QASM digest across source views
a version-pinned archive member or logical-recipe record with exact parameter/seed/version provenance that resolves to both observations
an explicit immutable source submission or workflow identifier shared by sources
a manually reviewed entry in the signed lineage registry that cites one of the preceding evidence types
non_evidence: same family name, width, backend, shots, gate counts, timestamps, or target value
similar DAG statistics or a fuzzy/similarity hash
a regenerated circuit selected only by an MQTBench family/width label
cross_source_lineage_rule.component_construction: Build the transitive closure of source-local leakage groups and admissible cross-source lineage edges. Its deterministic identifier is SHA-256 of canonical JSON {schema:'qre-unified-lineage-component-v2', members: sorted source-qualified local group identifiers}.
cross_source_lineage_rule.fold_conflict_policy: Every member of a lineage component must carry the same imported base outer fold. If a proven component has two base folds, materialization fails with CROSS_SOURCE_FOLD_CONFLICT. It must be adjudicated and signed by S62; a routine runner must not silently move any group.
cross_source_lineage_rule.no_evidence_policy: If no admissible cross-source edge exists, source-local groups remain separate components. This does not assert that circuits are semantically unrelated; it only states that the archive cannot prove a join.

required_balance_reporting: rows and leakage groups by source and outer fold
target median/IQR by source and outer fold, descriptive only
backend, family, width, shots and representation-tier distributions by source and outer fold when fields exist
empty source-fold or empty method-eligible train/test cell
master_outer_protocol.balance_policy: The imported assignment is not re-optimized using target labels. Materialization reports imbalance. A severe imbalance is a Gate-A issue, not permission to alter a frozen source fold.

nested_inner_protocol.population: For each outer k, only observations with outer_fold!=k participate. The outer test set has inner_fold=null and is never read by tuning, preprocessing, early stopping, calibration, or feature learning.

assignment_algorithm.algorithm: deterministic SHA-256 modulo assignment on unified_leakage_group_id
assignment_algorithm.reason: The group-level deterministic assignment is reproducible, creates no row-order dependence, and cannot place a leakage component in two inner folds.

nested_inner_protocol.inner_validation_definition: For selected inner fold j, eligible outer-train observations with inner_fold=j are validation; eligible outer-train observations with inner_fold!=j are inner-train.

minimum_support.requirement: A trainable method/panel must have at least four distinct unified leakage groups in the outer-train eligible population and each inner validation fold must contain at least one eligible group.
minimum_support.failure_action: Mark that method/panel/outer-fold unavailable_for_nested_selection. Do not collapse to row-wise CV, move groups, tune on outer-test, or report a five-fold primary score for that cell.
minimum_support.small_diagnostic_policy: A smaller panel may use a separately named predeclared diagnostic protocol only after strong-agent approval. It is not a substitute for the unified primary score.

inner_ledger.outer_train_rule: outer_role=train implies inner_fold_or_null is one of 0,1,2,3

training_and_calibration_firewall.shared_outer_assignment: Every trainable unified method uses the identical outer fold assignment. Method ineligibility may reduce training rows but never changes test membership or creates a method-specific split.
fit_scope: Fit scalers, imputers, feature selection, vocabulary/token dictionaries, backend/OOV encoders, graph normalization constants, target transforms, hyperparameters and early-stopping epoch choices on inner-train only during selection.
After selection, refit the frozen procedure using eligible complete outer-train rows only, then predict outer-test once.
Fit raw-to-observed affine/log-affine proxy calibration on outer-train only; raw and calibrated outputs are distinct method variants.
forbidden: reading outer-test labels during any preprocessing, model selection, calibration, early stopping or threshold choice
using source_id, row order, target-derived bins, observed runtime statistics, fold number or test-set availability as a primary pooled-model feature
fitting a source-specific model and presenting its concatenated predictions as one unified pooled model unless S62 explicitly names that ensemble variant
multiplying a 1,024-shot prediction by shots/1024 unless the separately named analytical method contract explicitly specifies shot-linear scaling
allowed_pre_execution_inputs: circuit structure at the declared lifecycle stage
shots, backend identity, instruction durations and frozen snapshot/calibration properties
representation availability/tier for reporting; its use as a feature requires a predeclared ablation

randomness_and_seed_policy.seed_reduction: Each neural method produces one held-out prediction per declared seed. The primary seed-ensemble prediction is the median across all declared seed predictions for the same canonical_observation_id and outer fold. Individual-seed metrics remain diagnostic.
randomness_and_seed_policy.deterministic_streams: Use benchmark_v1/registry/seed_registry.json. Derive child streams with the documented SHA-256 derivation; Python hash() is forbidden.
randomness_and_seed_policy.selection_prohibition: Never select a seed, checkpoint, hyperparameter setting or model epoch because it has the best outer-test score.

primary_estimands: equal-source-weight macro of source metrics where all included source metrics are defined
paired method deltas on the successful common held-out observation intersection
secondary_estimands: raw pooled row metric, explicitly diagnostic
backend/family/temporal/source-held-out diagnostics under their own named split contracts
paired_comparison_requirements: same outer split_assignment_hash and test fold
same canonical_observation_id multiset after multiplicity policy
both methods emitted valid predictions for the paired-error intersection
any different representation views are explicitly accepted in the signed method-by-dataset matrix and reported as a representation-qualified comparison
comparison_and_estimand_policy.coverage_rule: Paired error uses only the valid-prediction intersection. Coverage, terminal state counts and quality-pass rate are always computed against every attempted row in the predeclared panel; a method does not improve error by deleting unsupported, failed, timeout or OOM rows.
metrics: R2 and log-R2 only with non-zero target variance
grouped-bootstrap 95% intervals using the frozen bootstrap stream

bootstrap_clusters.pooled: source-qualified unified_leakage_group_id; source-balanced summaries resample within source before macro aggregation

must_verify: immutable corpus hash, total rows and source counts
one non-null outer fold in {0,1,2,3,4} for every canonical observation
one outer fold per unified leakage group and per proven cross-source lineage component
outer test versus train disjointness for every fold
exactly four inner folds only among each outer-train population; no outer-test row has an inner fold
inner train/validation group disjointness and no lineage component crossing an inner fold
every source-local historical group retained its imported source fold unless an S62-signed conflict resolution record exists
all proven cross-source lineage edges are present in the lineage registry and no non-evidence edge is introduced
minimum nested-support condition per method/panel/outer fold
prediction manifests record canonical observation identity, split hashes, method variant, terminal state, representation tier, environment and seed
fit manifests prove preprocessing/tuning/calibration used only permitted inner/outer train IDs
paired comparison tables have matching target/clock/split hashes and retain full-panel coverage separately
must_reject: row-wise random split for a grouped panel
cross-source lineage fold conflict without S62 decision
method-specific outer split or split hash
outer-test access in a fit/calibration manifest
a paired comparison whose target, clock, test identities or split hash differ
a score table that drops terminal non-prediction rows from its coverage denominator

gate_outputs.pass: Write a validation report with per-fold counts, group counts, source distribution, all set/split hashes and zero leakage assertions.
gate_outputs.fail: Write every violating canonical_observation_id/group/evidence ID and stop downstream execution. Do not repair assignment, tier, formula or lineage policy automatically.

acceptance_tests: Shuffling corpus row order leaves the outer and inner assignment maps keyed by canonical_observation_id unchanged.
Every source-local exact-QASM or workflow group maps to exactly one outer fold.
A verified cross-source duplicate maps to the same outer fold and, in every outer-train projection, the same inner fold.
Introducing a cross-source edge whose imported base folds differ produces CROSS_SOURCE_FOLD_CONFLICT and no split artifact.
No outer-test canonical_observation_id occurs in any inner-train, inner-validation, scaler, vocabulary, hyperparameter, early-stopping or proxy-calibration manifest for that outer fold.
Changing a prediction, model name, seed metric or dataframe order cannot alter the split assignment hash.
All methods declaring a unified RQPU-A result reference the byte-identical split_assignment_hash; method-specific eligibility only changes terminal state/coverage, not membership.
A paired table with different target_id, clock_id, fold assignment or canonical test identity is rejected even if it contains the same number of rows.
A neural aggregate that omits one declared seed or chooses a best seed is rejected from the primary scorecard.

replaces_for_v2_execution: per-method ad hoc outer split generation
row-wise split fallback for QPack or Qonductor
legacy v1/v5 split hashes as sufficient evidence for a V2 unified comparison
supersession.requires_before_execution: S62 must sign the representation/method matrix. C118 then materializes this contract without policy edits; S63 validates it before any checkpoint training.
